page.running_head: Constantinus II, Constans, Const. Lib. III. A. C.

main_text.p: pis ejectus in eremo delituit. Hilarius verò con-ventu Biterrensi in exilium pulsus est. Sexto in 357 Concilio Sirmiensi Photinus damnatus est, nova confessio, cui Hosius & Liberius, cruciatibus victi, subscripsère: & reduce Romam Liberio Felix ipsius Successor, quod Constantium haereseos damnassèt, trucidatus est. Septimo, dilludio 358 inter Arrianos ob Photinum exorto, Nicomediae Synodus celebrari debuit, sed, interveniente terræ motu, impedita est. Octavo duo Concilia celebrata sunt, unum Arimini, alterum Seleuciae. Ibi Nicaena fides damnatis Arrianis, confirmata est, cui mox aliam Constantius suppofuit, & Episcopos subscribere coëgit. Hic Arriani damnati,
Epiphan. haeref. 71. Athanas. de Synodo & Apost. 2, Sozom. l. 4. cap. 16. Socrat. l. 2. cap. 31. Theod. l. 2. cap. 27.

Sulpit. l. 2. Epiphan. haref. 73. Sozom. l. 4. cap. 26.patrocinante Conltantio ejectis Semi- Arrianis, fuere. Hoc tempore cantus genus, quod duo Chori commutato ordine alternatim pfallerent, Antiphona dictum, Antiochiæ à Flavia- no & Diodoro inftitutum eft, & à Dominica nova ad Calend. Novembr adhibebatur. page.notes: Marginal notes in left margin: "Epiphan. haeref. 71.", "Athanas. de Synodo & Apost. 2,", "Sozom. l. 4. cap. 16.", "Socrat. l. 2. cap. 31.", "Theod. l. 2. cap. 27." are transcribed above as a foot note with their references; the left margin also carries the printed reference marks. Some margin readings are uncertain; the wording of the side notes is approximate. The Latin word at the end of the text reads "brofius" as printed, likely Ambrosius with the initial letters damaged; transcribed as printed. Ornaments below the text are not transcribed. The heading "CAPUT" is a chapter heading at the foot.
